authority.legal_name: Region Stockholm — Waxholms Ångfartygs AB (Waxholmsbolaget), the public archipelago ferry operator within SL

mandate.summary: Region Stockholm runs the archipelago and commuter-boat network through Waxholmsbolaget and SL, connecting central Stockholm to hundreds of islands across the Baltic archipelago as part of the integrated public-transport system.
current_priorities: Year-round island access and commuter connections
Integrating water transport into the SL ticketing and network
Renewing an ageing diesel archipelago fleet
Protecting the sensitive Baltic archipelago environment

policy_targets.vision: Region Stockholm / City of Stockholm climate plan
policy_targets.decarb_note: Stockholm targets a fossil-fuel-free city by 2040, and the archipelago's diesel ferry fleet is one of the harder-to-abate parts of the public-transport system.
policy_targets.relevance: Navier is the zero-emission foiling upgrade to a network Region Stockholm already runs — faster commuter lines, quiet low-wake island access, and a clear path off diesel, with the Candela pilot already proving the city's appetite for electric foiling on the water.

precedent.headline: Public archipelago ferries are core infrastructure here, not a novelty.
precedent.network: Waxholmsbolaget and SL run a year-round network of dozens of vessels from Strömkajen and Stavsnäs across the inner, middle and outer archipelago, all ticketed inside SL — and Stockholm is already piloting the Candela P-12 electric foiling commuter ferry on the Ekerö line.
precedent.note: Public ferry service is core transport infrastructure here, not a novelty. Navier adds a fast passenger-only foiling layer on the busy corridors.

interpretation_for_navier: Navier is the zero-emission foiling upgrade to a network Region Stockholm already runs — faster commuter lines, quiet low-wake island access, and a clear path off diesel, with the Candela pilot already proving the city's appetite for electric foiling on the water.

domestic_network.note: Candidate boarding points with APPROXIMATE anchor coordinates [lng, lat] for Grok to snap to real piers/terminals during seal. Coordinates are anchors, not sealed geometry. Core mirrors the authority's live public stops; new/committed/study stops are flagged.

domestic_pairs.rationale: Busiest commuter line (SL 83) — central Stockholm to the inner-archipelago town.
Sjövägen (line 80) commuter hop linking the inner-harbour districts.
Inner-harbour commuter link across the central waterfront.
Gateway to the outer archipelago and the Sandhamn sailing hub.
Mid-archipelago island link north of Vaxholm.
Outer-island hop across the middle archipelago.
Mid-archipelago link to the Gällnö nature-reserve islands.

regional_links.note: Domestic-only network across the Stockholm archipelago and inner waterways. Any future Åland/Baltic links are clearly secondary and out of scope for this phase.

routing_hazards.instruction: Every domestic leg must be routed through navigable open water with NO land crossings (interior_land_km == 0). Hand-curated waypoints required wherever a breakwater, barrier, bridge pier, reef, headland, naval/exclusion zone or shallows would otherwise be clipped. Use data-clean/uae_hand_waypoints.json format {from, to, waypoints:[[lng,lat]...]}.

hazards.detail: The archipelago is a maze of skerries, rocks and shallows — every leg must follow the marked deep-water fairways; hand-waypoint around skerries and reefs.
Inner and middle archipelago routes ice over in winter; seasonal routing and ice-class limits apply — flag legs that need winter suspension.
Several middle-archipelago islands sit in nature reserves with strict wake limits; no-foil zones near landings and reserve shorelines.
Strömkajen/Slussen/Nybroplan are busy with sightseeing, commuter and Djurgården traffic — low-wake, geofenced no-foil zones in the inner harbour.
